Rooster Petroleum, LLC has successfully completed TA operations of the HI A-494 Well C-1 (ST01). 

Summary of Operations:

TT-CIBP in 3-1/2" tbg @ 6900' RKB + 51' cmt (TOC @ 6849' RKB); pressure tested to 1000 psi

Perf'd 3-1/2" tbg @ 6800' RKB; M&P 10.6 bbls (55 sxs) Class H cmt for 375' balanced cmt plug in 3-1/2" tbg & 3-1/2" x 7" annulus f/ 6425'-6800' RKB; pressure tested to 1000 psi

Cut/pulled 3-1/2" tbg f/ 775' RKB (476' BML)

Cut/pulled 7" csg f/ 750' RKB (451' BML)

CIBP in 10-3/4" csg @ 669' RKB (370' BML) + 50' cmt (TOC @ 619' RKB (320' BML); pressure tested to 1000 psi

M&P 19.25 bbls (100 sxs) CLass H cmt for 203' bal cmt plug in 10-3/4" csg f/ 396'-599' RKB (97'-300' BML)

Cut/pulled 10-3/4" csg f/ 334' RKB (35' BML)

Operations commenced 11/05/2016 and were completed 11/12/2016.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 05/08/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,698'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the EI 57 H-1ST1 well to produce the "BB-1" sand. The previous completion, the "BB-2" sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP at 11,616' MD and dumping 70' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 11,546' MD. The "BB-1" sand was perforated at intervals 11,471'-11,482', 11,487'-11,499', and 11,517'-11,527' MD. Operations began 05/29/11 and ended 06/02/11.

The A-12D well was shut in on 08/24/2017 due to Hurricane Harvey. In order to remain in compliance with CFR 250.829(a)(1) the PB valve assembly was pulled and a DS pump through style plug was set in the S-Nipple at 5774' MD.

Operation Completed 12/13/2017

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 07/26/2025.

eWell recognizes a TA date of 03/08/2013 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug.

Stone spud the MP 72 OCS-G 03417, Well No. 08 on May 05, 2008 and TD'd the well on May 17, 2008 at a depth of 1585' MD / TVD.  Well test operations of the "Caprock" formation were conducted. The test were unsuccessfull as the well flowed only water. The well was plugged and abandoned on June 04, 2008.

VR287#A1 original temporary abandonment operations completed 8/21/1992 (well status date unchanged).  Additional cement plugs set as indicated on attached as-built wellbore schematic during this operation.

Unsuccessful Temporary Change Zone:
ERT attempted to temporarily produce the P-1-1A Sand by closing and opening sliding sleeves.  Sleeves would not close.  Plugs were set but did not test.  Plugs were removed and ERT resumed production of the current completion, the P-1-4 Sand.

WELLBORE 002 ST 00 BP 00 IS P/A. WILL DRILL 002 ST 01 BP 00.
1. Change the Well Plug Type for the 28180-29206 ft plug to DCP on the Plug Installation Info page - e-well will not me change the plug type.

Utilize coil tubing to temporarily abandon the Chris K zone to place a cement plug across the perforations. (Well had been re-completed to the Cris K zone in 2001.)
Temporary abandonment operations of the wellbore will be completed with a platform rig at a later date.

Removed Archer packer, cut & pulled 14" casing, installed 16" CIBP w/633 bbls of 16.2 Class H cement on top for SCP. CIBP was tagged (20k)and pressure tested (1540 psi), Cement positive tested to 1750psi and negative tested to sea water equivalent.

The proposed operations were to pull packoff from the tubing, establish injection into the I-2 sand, pump acid job, reinstall packoff and return well to production.  

Operations deemed unsuccessful.  ERT shut the well in due to a hole in the tubing close to the GLV mandrel @ 6117'.  ERT will perform a workover on the well at a later date.

Well conductors A4, A5, A9, A10, A6, A15 found to be clamped together to bell guide template.  Cut & Remove 7-5/8", 10-3/4" & 26" @ bell guide on +10 deck.  Operations took place from 7/27/2017 - 9/30/2017.

Paul the E-2, E-4, E-5, E-6 and E-7 wells were plugged by Continental Oil Company in 1976 before Nexen became operator of the WD 45 lease. We do not have any paperwork on these wells. They had to have submitted a sundry notice outlining P&A procedure and a follow-up sundry outlining the testing of the P&As to the MMS back when the work was performed. 

Cut and pull conductors and casings

The VR 348 #1ST wellbore was spud on 07-16-07.  KOP was 7702' MD. The well was drilled to a TD of 8372' MD / 4435' TVD on August 17, 2007.  A 5 1/2" production liner was set at 8370' MD / 4433' TVD and the wellbore was temporarily abandon of 07-25-07.

This EOR is being submitted to reflect the installation of gas-lift valves in the subject well on 11/28/08. Attached is a current wellbore schematic showing the live gas-lift valves.  Please change the well status to "Gas Lift Oil".

Second attempt to recomplete well was unsuccessful. Set 9-5/8" CIBP @ 4428' RKB and additional 200' cmt plug f/1500' - 1700'RKB on 08/25/11. Well status remains the same. Current wellbore schematic is attached.

VR 171 Well A005 was temporarily abandoned with all plugs in place.   Attempts to cut/pull 10-3/4", 16" and 36" casings were unsuccessful.   Due to heavy lifting equipment needed and equipment availability, operations to cut/pull casings were suspended until Spring 2017 at time of platform removal.

Drilling operations commenced cased hole sidetrack from 14" previously plugged back. The ST02BP01 wellbore was unintentionally sidetracked to 19,360' MD / 17,109' TVD when attempting to access ST02BP00.  Decision was made to simultaneously plugback ST02BP00 and ST02BP01 in order to drill cased hole sidetrack.  A cement retainer was set at 19,031' MD/16,837' TVD.  505 cu.ft. cement squeezed below and 56 cu.ft. spotted above.  The abandonment plug was positively pressure tested to 4715 psi with 14.0 ppg DHMW.

Stone has successfully performed initial completion operations of the Vermilion Block 268, OCS-G 02082, Well J6BP2.  The well was completed as a singel, GP, gas completion in the "K-4" Sand with perforated alternates in the "K-3" & "K-2" Sands.  See attachment "Current Wellbore" for details.
